shots.actions: a welding torch arcs against the rusted roller door leaf and the weld seam grows from nothing into one continuous gate bar; sparks fall on the cement floor leaving a momentary warm point only at the contact spot, the rest of the hall under cold industrial light; steel racks are lifted into a stacked cover and steel stock with the water bucket are piled to the inner ring
